name: stockwise
description: Indian (NSE/BSE) and US stock data, mutual funds, F&O, your portfolio and tax as read-only tools.
long_description: StockWise is a stock market toolkit for the terminal. This extension runs its MCP server locally: quotes, price history, technical indicators, risk, Indian mutual funds (AMFI NAVs, SIP returns), F&O option chains and strategy payoffs, screens, backtests, and your own StockWise portfolio, lots, capital-gains estimate, calendar, watchlist and alerts. Every tool only reads data; nothing places orders. Market data comes from Yahoo Finance, NSE/BSE and AMFI; your portfolio stays in local files. Educational information, not financial advice.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Stock quotes. Live (often delayed) quotes for up to 20 tickers: price, change, day range, volume, 52-week range, market cap, P/E.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Price history. OHLCV bars for one ticker over a period (5-minute bars for 1d, daily up to 6mo, weekly to 2y, monthly beyond).

tools.name: technical
tools.description: Technical indicators. Indicators for one ticker: SMA 10/20/50/100/200, EMA 12/26, RSI(14), MACD, Bollinger Bands, ATR, VWAP, and a bullish/bearish tally of the signals.

tools.name: risk
tools.description: Risk metrics. Risk of one ticker from daily closes over a period: return, annualized volatility and risk level, Sharpe, Sortino and Calmar ratios, max drawdown (peak, trough, length) and 95%/99% one-day value at risk.

tools.name: verdict
tools.description: 6-pillar scorecard. Quantitative 6-pillar scores for one ticker (valuation, growth, balance sheet, ownership, analysts, technical trend) with a 0-100 composite, data coverage and the facts behind each score. Not a recommendation.

tools.name: scorecard
tools.description: Piotroski F-Score & Altman Z-Score. Audit-grade accounting scorecards for one ticker with every criterion's formula and pass/fail.

tools.name: insights
tools.description: Fundamental & ownership insights. Categorized positive, negative and neutral impact cards plus shareholding breakdown (Promoter, FII, DII, Public) for one ticker.

tools.name: events
tools.description: Corporate events & disclosures. Recent and upcoming corporate events for one ticker with 1-day and 5-day price reaction.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find a ticker. Search tickers by company name ("tata motors", "apple").

tools.name: markets
tools.description: Market indices. Index levels and day change: the chosen market first (NIFTY 50, SENSEX, BANK NIFTY, India 10Y yield; or S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow), then the other; optional crypto, FX and one benchmark per global exchange.

tools.name: mf_search
tools.description: Find a mutual fund. Search Indian mutual fund schemes (AMFI) by name words, e.g.

tools.name: mf_nav
tools.description: Mutual fund NAV and returns. Latest NAV of an Indian mutual fund scheme by AMFI code or ISIN, with its category, fund house and expense ratio (TER) from AMFI.

tools.name: mf_sip
tools.description: Mutual fund SIP returns. What a monthly SIP in an Indian mutual fund would have returned over a period: invested, current value, gain and XIRR.

tools.name: options_chain
tools.description: Option chain. Option chain for an index or stock (NSE/BSE for India, Yahoo for US): strikes around the money with calls and puts, OI, volume, IV and greeks.

tools.name: options_pcr
tools.description: Put/call ratio. Put/call ratio by open interest and volume for an underlying's expiry, with total call and put OI.

tools.name: options_oi
tools.description: Open-interest analytics & build-up. Put/Call Ratio, Max Pain strike, top Call resistance and Put support OI walls, and institutional build-up classification.

tools.name: options_maxpain
tools.description: Max pain. Max-pain strike for an underlying's expiry (where option writers lose least) and its distance from the spot.

tools.name: options_payoff
tools.description: Option strategy payoff. Payoff of a preset option strategy at expiry from live premiums: max profit and loss, breakevens, probability of profit and a payoff table.

tools.name: screen
tools.description: Stock screen. Run a preset screen over the market's popular stocks: undervalued (P/E under 15), growth (forward EPS above trailing), dividend (yield over 2%), momentum (top daily gainers) or bluechip (largest market caps).

tools.name: backtest
tools.description: Backtest a strategy. Backtest a built-in strategy on one ticker's daily history with Indian or US trading costs: total return vs buy-and-hold, CAGR, max drawdown, Sharpe, win rate, trades.

tools.name: portfolio_summary
tools.description: Portfolio summary. The user's StockWise portfolio valued at current prices: each holding's quantity, average cost, price, value, P&L and weight, totals and XIRR.

tools.name: holdings_lots
tools.description: Holding lots. The user's purchase lots (quantity, price, date, days held, short or long term) for one holding or all, oldest first — what FIFO sales and tax use — and their most recent sales.

tools.name: tax_estimate
tools.description: Capital gains estimate. Estimated capital-gains tax for the user's portfolio: realized gains this tax year and unrealized gains by short/long term, with India's set-off rules and the ₹1.25 lakh LTCG exemption (or US/UK rules).

tools.name: tax_advance
tools.description: Indian advance tax schedule. Quarterly Indian advance tax schedule (15 Jun, 15 Sep, 15 Dec, 15 Mar) under Section 208/211 with Section 234C(1) capital-gains proviso protections.

tools.name: harvest
tools.description: Tax-loss & LTCG exemption harvesting. Lot-level tax-loss harvesting candidates plus unused Section 112A ₹1.25L annual LTCG tax-gain harvesting capacity.

tools.name: rebalance
tools.description: Portfolio rebalance plan. Rebalance plan for the user's portfolio against target weights or equal weight, with drift tolerance and inflow-only support.

tools.name: portfolio_pme
tools.description: Public Market Equivalent (Index Twin). Mirrors the user's exact cash flows into a passive benchmark (SPY, VOO, VWCE, NIFTY 50) to compute Kaplan-Schoar PME, Direct Alpha and benchmark twin value.

tools.name: portfolio_sell_preview
tools.description: Preview a sale without recording it: departing FIFO lots, short- vs long-term tax with the Sec. 112A exemption and cess, a long-term countdown and a mutual-fund exit-load check.

tools.name: mf_bleed
tools.description: Held Regular-plan funds vs their Direct twin: TER gap, yearly and 10-year cost, and units that can switch tax-free.

tools.name: calendar
tools.description: Results and dividends calendar. Upcoming results dates, ex-dividend dates and splits for given tickers, or for the user's holdings and watchlist when none are given.

tools.name: ipo_board
tools.description: Indian IPO board. Indian IPOs from NSE: issues open now, upcoming and recently listed, with price band, lot size, minimum application, live QIB/NII/retail subscription and an IPO-market regime.

tools.name: ipo_analyze
tools.description: Indian IPO analysis. Deep analysis of one Indian IPO: issue structure, subscription by category, demand by price, SEBI allotment odds, unofficial GMP and a 6-pillar score with demand and long-term profile labels. Not a recommendation.

tools.name: goal_sip
tools.description: SIP for a goal. Monthly SIP needed to reach a target amount by a horizon (years, months or a date), with a horizon-matched return, tax and exit load at redemption, P10/P50/P90 outcome bands and a return sensitivity.

tools.name: goal_retire
tools.description: Retirement corpus. Corpus needed to retire on today's monthly expenses (grown by inflation) for a number of years, and the monthly SIP that builds it.

tools.name: goal_education
tools.description: Education goal. Future cost of an education from today's cost and education inflation, and the monthly SIP that pays for it.

tools.name: goal_swp
tools.description: SWP runway. How long a corpus lasts under monthly withdrawals that rise with inflation: equity SWP (tax on the gain share) against an FD (interest at the slab rate).

tools.name: goal_prepay
tools.description: Loan prepayment vs SIP. Exact interest and tenure saved against P10/P50/P90 after-tax SIP outcomes and the before-tax return a SIP needs to break even.

tools.name: goal_list
tools.description: Saved goals. The user's saved goals with months left, value of linked holdings (live prices, or cost basis when offline: see valued_at), funded share and the monthly SIP still needed.

tools.name: alerts_list
tools.description: Price alerts. The user's alerts (price, RSI, moving-average crosses, breakouts, results dates) checked against live data: triggered, waiting, no_price or no_data.

tools.name: watchlist
tools.description: Watchlist. The user's watchlist with live prices and day change.

market.title: Default market
market.description: Market for bare tickers: in (NSE), us, crypto, fx, commodity, uk, de, jp, hk, sg, ca or au.
